name: pollevbot
description: A response bot for multiple-choice polls on PollEverywhere

DAY_OF_WEEK.description: Cron string specifying weekdays to run pollevbot

HOUR.description: Cron string specifying which hours to run pollevbot

MINUTE.description: Cron string specifying what minutes to run pollevbot

LOGIN_TYPE.description: Login protocol to use (uw or pollev on Heroku; nus requires a local desktop browser)

ANSWER_MODE.description: Answer strategy: random, llm, theme with a local GGUF model, or skip

ANSWER_THEME.description: Course topic for theme mode; required when no interactive terminal is available

MAX_OPTION.description: Optional exclusive option bound; unset means all options except the legacy Scheduler random default

OPEN_WAIT.description: Seconds to wait before answering a newly opened activity

POLL_REQUEST_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout in seconds for activity, CSRF, and submit requests

POLL_RETRY_LIMIT.description: Maximum safe attempts before skipping an activity

POLL_RETRY_BACKOFF.description: Initial retry delay in seconds; later delays double

LLM_BACKEND.description: Local model backend, currently llama_cpp only

LLM_MODEL_PATH.description: Absolute path to a provisioned GGUF model; needed in llm and theme modes

LLM_THREADS.description: CPU inference threads; unset defaults to half the CPU count

LLM_GPU_LAYERS.description: Number of model layers to offload to GPU

LLM_MCQ_MAX_TOKENS.description: Maximum generated tokens for a multiple-choice answer

LLM_OPEN_MAX_TOKENS.description: Maximum generated tokens for an open-ended answer

LLM_MAX_OPEN_CHARS.description: Maximum characters in an open-ended answer

LLM_FAILURE_POLICY.description: On MCQ model failure: skip by default or explicitly choose random

LIFETIME.description: Time to run pollevbot before terminating (in seconds). Set to inf to run forever.
